papers.abstract: BackgroundAging is associated with progressive neuromuscular decline and sarcopenia, increasing the risk of mortality. These changes may result in structural foot deformities and severely compromised stability, thereby increasing the risk of falls. papers.abstract: Over the past decade, running shoes have undergone substantial innovation with the emergence of Advanced Footwear Technology (AFT). Shoes with AFT are typically characterized by highly compliant (deformable) and resilient (high energy return) midsole foams, embedded curved stiffening elements, low mass, and a rockered longitudinal geometry. papers.abstract_zh: 摇板中底在跑鞋中的应用日益广泛，但其定义、术语和结局指标在研究界和商业界存在很大差异。目的本范围综述旨在梳理学术文献中对摇板的定义、主要鞋履品牌对摇板的描述，以及最常评估的结局指标。方法通过对四个学术数据库进行系统检索，开展范围综述，识别 19项符合条件的研究。 还对八大领先鞋类品牌的商业材料进行了研究，以评估对弧形底特征的非学术性描述。结果：学术文献使用了多种术语和几何描述，如顶点位置、弧形底角度、曲率半径和前掌翘起，但未找到用于分类弧形底的一致定义或阈值。商业描述依赖于定性的品牌专用语言

papers.venue: Journal of foot and ankle research
papers.abstract: IntroductionOff-road activities such as trail running and hiking have undergone a significant surge in global popularity over the last 2 decades, but this engagement also raises the potential for musculoskeletal injuries, which are prevalent and comparable to rates reported in road running. Footwear is critical in these dynamic environments, incorporating features such as aggressive outsole patterns and structural stability elements to accommodate varied and rugged terrain.MethodsGiven the limited synthesis and fragmented nature of the literature, this scoping review systematically mapped and summarised existing research on the influence of footwear in hiking and trail running.
